title: School-trip Wi-Fi wants your social login
scenario: On a school trip, a café Wi-Fi page offers faster access if you log in with Instagram or TikTok. The page looks polished and the network name matches the café.

answers.A: Use the social login because it is faster and the café name matches the Wi-Fi network.
answers.B: Ask staff for the official network and use basic guest access without handing over a social-media password.
answers.C: Use mobile data or wait if the network requires an unrelated account login.

explanation: Anyone nearby can create a network with the same name. Free Wi-Fi should not require credentials to an unrelated high-value account.
proTip: The Wi-Fi needs internet access, not your social identity.
